description: Baidu Tongji collect hits on hm.baidu.com/hm.gif, whose site ID rides as si. The loader hm.js?{siteId} puts that ID in a nameless query string and is not contracted.

params.name: si
params.description: It is the 32-hex Tongji site ID. Baidu documents that ID on `hm.js?{siteId}`. Collect hits send it as `si`, so this rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Set `si` to the 32-character site ID from Tongji code installation.
